title: How to Convert Minutes Into Hours and Minutes
description: A simple division trick for converting a minute count like 150 into hours and minutes.
narration_lines: Converting minutes into hours is just division.
There are 60 minutes in every hour, so divide by 60.
150 divided by 60 is 2, with 30 left over.

steps.label: There are 60 minutes in an hour

params.footnote: divide by 60 — the remainder is extra minutes
